sections.advice: This Scenic stretch near Collier Row → High point near Stone stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Oxted → Near Croydon is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: For 38 km this is Route des Grandes Alpes, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Lavaux Vineyard Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-littoral-de-chens-sur-leman-petit.story: 280 km from Chens-sur-Léman to Chens-sur-Léman, about 4 h 50 of riding. It goes by way of Stations de Morges, The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier, Les Roseaux and Petite villa au bord du lac Léman. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Tihău - Dealul Cucului → Treznea-Coasta Ciungii 2
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
